title: Bluesky expands its AI-powered Attie app to let anyone build websites, games, and more
slides: What if anyone could build apps without coding?
Bluesky's Attie now lets users create websites and games
But the AI decides what you can actually build
Your next side project might skip developers entirely
Try Attie today: what will you create first?
thread_text:
1. No Code Needed

Bluesky's Attie lets users create websites and games just by describing them. The AI handles the building part — but not the deciding part.

2. AI Picks Your Limits

Attie decides what you can actually build. You bring the idea; the AI determines what's possible. That's a quiet shift in who holds creative control.

3. Skip the Developer

Your next side project might not need a coder at all. Instead, you write a prompt and iterate with an AI that chooses the boundaries for you.

4. Who's Really Building?

If the AI selects the features, are you the creator or just the requester? The line between tool and author gets blurry fast.

5. Try It Yourself

Go to Attie and describe one small app you've always wanted. See what the AI lets you make — and what it quietly blocks.

instagram.caption:
You can now describe a website or a game and watch it get built without writing a single line of code. 🛠️

Bluesky's Attie opens up to anyone who wants to create.

The catch: the AI itself decides what you're actually allowed to build. So you bring the idea, but it sets the limits.

If the tool picks the boundaries, you're less an author and more a requester. 🤔

Next time you need a small app for work, you might not call a developer at all.

Go try Attie and describe one thing you've always wanted. What will it let you make? 👀
